**For most households, I’d choose the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar panel kit.** It has a 2,073.6 Wh battery, and the listing says that’s enough to run a fridge and CPAP through a day and night. It’s listed at $1,199; the seller page says code **DEALECTRIC** takes $59.95 off. [Buy the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit) · [Read the sizing guide](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-hurricane-season)

One caveat for hurricane season: **200 W of solar won’t recharge quickly under heavy clouds**, so charge the battery from the wall before a storm and treat the panel as help for sunny periods—not guaranteed power during the storm. If you want a lower-priced option, the same guide lists a BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit at $729.
